name: Notible Notifications
description: A bell in the sidebar that keeps what Notible told you — reminders and automation messages — so a missed notification isn't gone. Also simple reminders: a message, a date and a time.
author: Notible
guide:
Click the **bell** in the sidebar to see recent notifications; the number on it counts the unread ones. **Clear** empties the list.

To set a reminder, open the bell and choose **+ Reminder**: type what to remind you of, pick a date and a time, and click **Add**. It works without Automations or a calendar.
